description: Crypto wallet for AI agents on Ethereum, Polygon, Base and Solana. The agent gets an API key, never a private key, and your spending limits and allowlist are checked before anything is signed. Send, swap, bridge, trade on Polymarket and get paid through escrow.

interface.shortDescription: Crypto wallets for AI agents, with spending limits
interface.longDescription: Adds OpenClawCash wallets to Codex on Ethereum, Polygon, Base and Solana. The agent gets an API key, never a private key, and every action is checked against your spending limits, allowlist and testnet-only rules before anything is signed. Send, swap, bridge, trade on Polymarket and get paid through escrow, over the OpenClawCash MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Use my OpenClawCash wallet here in Codex. Ask my write-approval mode before the first write action, then follow it.
